items.title: De De Pierce Interview, 1960-01-10
items.q: My old friend. In fact, I mean all the boys.

ctx.x: And he told me, look on the back, look who Billy liked that. I said, I know that ain't Billy on the back. And my goodness, I'll tell you the truth, if that wasn't Billy in a way, I'll eat my hat. It ain't no joke. Who could be Billy's twin? I got out the line and run the door and grab her, you know. And the woman faced me and I saw it with me and I suppose she had a boy in front of something in the line like this fella there believing in the dice, I would have got hurt. Yeah. You know, and I come back there and…
I saw John today on the bus. He got on the bus.
John Casimir. John Casimir. Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. I told him I'm coming down to the street. Yeah.
My old friend. In fact, I mean all the boys.
Who worked with you when you were in John's band?
